page_title: STU 1-1 UNI | Stuttgart v Union Berlin 18/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
90+2' Steffen Baumgart has decided to make a change. Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) replaces Andrej Ilic.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jeremy Arevalo (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Josha Vagnoman.
90' We are about to witness a subsitution. Lorenz Assignon (VfB Stuttgart) for Ramon Hendriks.
90' Problems for Sebastian Hoeness as Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Chema Andres replaces him.
89' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

88' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) was close to scoring a goal after unleashing a first-time effort from inside the six-yard box. The ball was aimed towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper read it well and pulled off a brilliant save to thwart the attempt.
87' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar.
85' Alexander Nubel pulls off a great save to block a header from Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) after a nice lofted cross.
85' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Frederik Ronnow intercepts the ball.

83' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the top left corner. The assist goes to Stanley Nsoki and the score changes to 1:1.
80' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) squandered a big chance from inside the box, firing his volley narrowly over the bar. What a waste.
79' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) unleashes a powerful first-time volley towards goal, but the ball goes well wide of the left post.
78' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
75' Sebastian Hoeness decides to make a substitution. Chris Fuhrich will be replaced by Finn Jeltsch (VfB Stuttgart).
75' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Nikolas Nartey and he is replaced by Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart).
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andras Schafer trots off the pitch and is replaced by Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin).
73' Stanley Nsoki (Union Berlin) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches wide of the left post.

72' Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Deniz Aytekin stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Union Berlin win a free kick.
69' Here is a change. Josip Juranovic is going off and Steffen Baumgart gives the last tactical orders to Stanley Nsoki (Union Berlin).
69' A substitution has been made. Livan Burcu is replaced by Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin).
66' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) latched on to a precise cross, but his bullet header missed the target. He should have done much better.

59' 1 - 0 Ramon Hendriks passes to Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom left corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 1:0.
55' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
54' The ball goes out for a corner. Union Berlin can continue in their attacking effort.
54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Union Berlin.
54' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Union Berlin will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
53' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul.
49' None of the Stuttgart players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

49' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range low towards the middle of the net, but Frederik Ronnow was alert and made an amazing save! Good work from Stuttgart as they win a corner.
48' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Deniz Aytekin has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
43' Union Berlin earn a corner.
41' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
37' Good chance! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
35' Union Berlin can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

34' Livan Burcu (Union Berlin) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
28' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
28' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Union Berlin comes to nothing.
26' What a beautiful long-range strike by Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart). He is quite unlucky as his shot flies just over the bar.
22' A nice pass gives Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) the opportunity to shoot, but it's a weak shot and sails well wide of the left post.
18' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Frederik Ronnow, who smothers the ball.
15' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
13' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) creates a good chance for himself and fires in a powerful close-range shot, but his effort ricochets off the right post.
11' Union Berlin take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
10' The corner is swung in but Union Berlin can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
7' A poor effort from Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) is easily gathered by Frederik Ronnow.
6' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! He sent the ball into the stands. What a miserable header!
4' Stuttgart take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
4' Stuttgart have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Stuttgart win a corner.
1' Deniz Aytekin shows the yellow card to Livan Burcu (Union Berlin) for a heavy challenge.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Union Berlin will have the kick-off.
Deniz Aytekin got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
